buttonization: formatted-only (strong = primary, em = secondary, both = accent)
breakpointRule: min-width media queries written as (width >= N); chrome switches mobile/desktop at 768; crisis tab floats at 1024
container: --va-container 1024px; --va-container-pad 16px (<768) / 32px (>=768); default content capped, block wrappers full-bleed — each block owns its container
tokens: --va-* in styles/styles.css :root (ink, link, navy, primary-dark, gray-lightest(-2), border(-dark), rule, crisis, info-bg, info-accent, gold, font-sans, font-serif)

fonts.faces: styles/fonts.css (Source Sans Pro Web 400/700 + italics, Bitter 400/700, OFL)

chromeDocuments./nav: sections classified by content: banner | crisis (+modal) | tools (logo, Search, Contact us, Sign in, Menu) | mega panels (h2 title; h3 hub + h4/ul columns, or h3 + ul columns) | links (ul)
chromeDocuments./footer: sections: crisis line | 4 columns (h2 + ul parts) | language (last h2 section) | logo (home link) | bottom links (ul)
chromeDocuments.robots: Robots | noindex metadata row on both

chromeIcons: decorative chrome images served from /icons/ (flag, dot-gov, https, VCL icon, arrows, plus/minus, header-logo.png, va-logo-white.png, stars.png)
crisisModal: owned by the header block; any element with class crisis-open (any block) opens it via a delegated document click listener
dynamicTiers: Sign in = link to https://www.va.gov/sign-in (interim); search submits GET https://www.va.gov/search/?query= (interim)
blockNaming: page blocks: kebab-case, one block per prototype section (blocks/<name>/<name>.{js,css}); CSS scoped under .<name>; class names kebab-case (no BEM __); no <header> elements inside blocks; reuse --va-* tokens only
internalLinks: the 5 in-scope pages are root-relative extensionless without trailing slash (/, /health-care, /housing-assistance, /life-insurance, /family-and-caregiver-benefits); every other va.gov URL stays absolute https://www.va.gov/…
editability: chrome is template-slotted: authored elements are MOVED (EW1); mobile copies are instrumentation-stripped clones (EW4)
